turns.text: Hi, you've reached Copper Wok Eastside. What can I do for you?
I'd like to order the shrimp fried rice and the scallion pancakes and the kung pao chicken for delivery please.
Also, my son has a dairy allergy.
Thanks for telling me. Just to confirm, that's a dairy allergy for your son?
Our allergen list doesn't show dairy in what you ordered. We do cook everything in one kitchen, so there is some risk of cross-contact.
Happy to. What address should we deliver to?
You're inside our delivery zone. That's shrimp fried rice and scallion pancakes and kung pao chicken, $49.50 with the delivery fee. We'll text you when the driver leaves.
Can I get a name and phone number for the order?
